question:
Directions: In this section, each of the following sentences has a blank space and each sentence is followed by four options. Select the most appropriate option to fill the blank space.

It seemed as if _____ who had gone camping had an adventure story.
solution:
The correct answer is '**everyone**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The blank needs a **pronoun**.
 
• '**everyone**' is a pronoun which means every person.
 
 
• Example- "**everyone **needs time to unwind"
 
 
 
• Clearly, '**everyone**' is the most appropriate determiner to fill in the blank in the sentence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **each**: used to refer to every one of two or more people or things, regarded and identified separately. (**प्रत्येक**)

 "each battery is in a separate compartment"
 
 
• Example- "**each **battery is in a separate compartment"
 
 
 
• **none**: no person; no one. **कोई आदमी; किसी को भी नहीं।**
 
 
• Example- "**none **could match her looks"
 
 
 
• ​**someone: **an unknown or unspecified person; some person.
 
 
• Example- "there's **someone **at the door"
